# Infinite Creations Website - Frontend

This is a React project for Infinite Creations, a web design and software company.

## Brand Guidelines

- **Company Name**: Infinite Creations
- **Primary Colors**:
  - Black (#000000) for text and main elements
  - Red (#FF4444 or similar) for accents and highlights
- **Style**: Modern, professional, clean design
- **Industry**: Web design and software development

## Project Structure

- Built with React and Vite
- Focus on modern, responsive design
- Component-based architecture
- Clean, maintainable code

## Code Style

- Use functional components with hooks
- Follow React best practices
- Implement responsive design
- Use semantic HTML
- Maintain accessibility standards
